mods.name: Cheat Engine (turn on first)
mods.description: Required: turn this on first, before any other cheat. It loads the code all the other cheats use. Leave it on; the other cheats switch themselves on and off. Without it, the other cheats do nothing.

mods.name: Infinite Health + No Hit Flinch
mods.description: Refills Batman's health to full and keeps it full. Enemy hits are ignored, so Batman doesn't flinch or stagger and your combo isn't broken. Scripted instant deaths still apply.

mods.name: 1 Hit Kill
mods.description: Any hit from Batman knocks out regular thugs and gunmen in one go. Titan thugs and bosses take normal damage so their fights still work.

mods.name: 1 Hit Max Combo
mods.description: Your first hit in a fight jumps the combo straight to x40 (max combo level), unlocking combo specials right away.

mods.name: Unlock All Upgrades
mods.description: Tap it once and every WayneTech upgrade unlocks right away: armor, combat moves and gadget upgrades, story-locked ones included, no points needed. Your max health goes up straight away. Every tap unlocks again, whether the box shows on or off. The Sonic, Multi and Remote Control Batarangs appear after you close the upgrade menu once or reload.

mods.name: Remove All Upgrades
mods.description: Tap it once to remove every WayneTech upgrade, including the Sonic, Multi and Remote Control Batarangs those upgrades give you, and get your upgrade points back. Every tap removes again, whether the box shows on or off. Save and reload so health, moves and gadgets update. Story gadgets are not touched.

mods.name: Hide Upgrade Prompt
mods.description: Hides the 'Touchpad for Upgrade' message on your HUD. Any upgrade points you have are kept and can still be spent in the upgrade menu.

mods.name: Riddle Scan Fix
mods.description: Turn this on if scanning a riddle answer (like the portrait) does nothing at all. It clears the story locks that keep riddle scanning and Riddler challenges switched off, so you can scan as normal. Turn it off again once you've scanned.

mods.name: Passive Enemies
mods.description: Regular enemies can't spot you, never take an attack turn and never fire their guns, story fights included. You can still beat them up. Titans and bosses are not affected.

mods.name: Enemies Can't Follow
mods.description: Regular enemies don't chase you down or close in on you during fights; they stay where they are. Titans and bosses are not affected.

mods.name: Speed Boost (2x)
mods.description: Batman moves twice as fast on foot (and flies twice as fast with Fly Mode).

mods.name: Infinite Gliding
mods.description: Glide forever without losing height. While gliding, push the left stick up to climb and down to descend; let go and Batman holds his height. Release the glide button to drop as normal. Ceilings and floors still stop him.

mods.name: Grapple Boost
mods.description: Arkham City style: press X any time while Batman is being pulled up the grapple line. When he reaches the top he launches high into the air and straight into a glide. A tap is enough for the launch; hold X afterwards to keep gliding (or use Infinite Gliding). Works on ledges and gargoyles.

mods.name: Grapple While Gliding
mods.description: While gliding, real grapple points (ledges the game lets you grapple to) show the R1 icon from very far away: reach is 200x normal, the normal angle limit is kept and the zone limit is lifted. Press R1 to grapple for real: rope, pull, climb-up or perch. Only real grapple points work. With Grapple Boost on, press X during the pull to launch into a glide again.

mods.name: Grapple Anywhere
mods.description: Press R1 when no grapple icon is showing (on foot or while gliding) to fire the grapple wherever the camera is aiming, up to about 100 m: walls, rooftops, anything. Batman is pulled in on the rope and set down on the ledge top (or just off the wall). Normal grapple points still work as usual.

mods.name: Slow-Mo (0.5x)
mods.description: The whole game runs at half speed: bullet-time fights, gliding and grappling. Turn it off to go back to normal speed.

mods.name: Speed Up (2x)
mods.description: The whole game runs at double speed. If Slow-Mo is also on, Slow-Mo wins.

mods.name: Hide HUD
mods.description: Hides everything on screen (health, XP, prompts, gadget icons) for clean screenshots and videos. Turn it off to bring the HUD back.

mods.name: Unlock All Riddler Maps
mods.description: Tap once: every area's Riddler map is marked as found, so all secrets show on the map. Every tap applies it again.

mods.name: Faster Grapple
mods.description: Batman is pulled up the grapple line much faster. The normal climb-up at the top still plays.

mods.name: Super Jump
mods.description: Click L3 (press the left stick) while on foot to launch high into the air with extra forward speed. Hold X in the air to glide.

mods.name: Combo Never Drops
mods.description: Your combo meter never resets: no timeout, and getting hit or using gadgets doesn't break it.

mods.name: Infinite Explosive Gel
mods.description: The explosive gel never runs out: you can have up to 50 gel charges placed at once. Turn it off to go back to the normal limit.

mods.name: Save Position
mods.description: Tap once to save where Batman is standing (and which way he's facing). Tap again any time to save a new spot. With Free Camera on, it saves the camera's spot instead.

mods.name: Load Position
mods.description: Tap once to teleport Batman back to the spot saved with Save Position. Every tap loads it again.

mods.name: Free Camera
mods.description: Batman turns invisible and the camera flies freely with Fly Mode controls (left stick = move where the camera points, R2 = up, L2 = down) for photos and exploring. Turn it off and Batman is put back exactly where he was.

mods.name: Fly Mode / No Clip
mods.description: Fly through anything. Left stick = move where the camera points (look up/down to climb/dive), R2 = up, L2 = down. Safe to turn off anywhere: if you're inside a wall or floor you keep flying until you're in open space.
